summary: CONV-1 v2 follow-up E2E tested. D2 free metering on all 3 new tools (budget-calc, classification-check, contribution-estimator) works correctly for fresh FREE users: 1st POST 200, 2nd POST 429 cooldown_active, /api/free-tool/usage returns limit=1 remaining=0 window_days=120. E5/E6 legal pages render with draft banners, A$24.50/A$49.50 copy, 0 em-dashes, and are linked from footer + pricing page + cancel modal. E3 cancel flow confirmed 2-click (cancel-plan-btn -> modal with keep/confirm + legal-links; no interstitial). ToolGate shown for anon on all 3 pages. FreeAllowanceBadge visible for logged-in FREE user on BC, CSC, CE (last wizard step reached via 2 nexts). HOWEVER: ONE HIGH-severity backend bug found: `_enforce_free_tool_limit` reads user.trial_ends_at (stale) instead of loading the subscription record, so trial fixtures whose user.trial_ends_at is in the past (but subscription.trial_ends_at is still future) are INCORRECTLY metered as free. Repro: trialactive@example.com has user.trial_ends_at=2026-11-07 (past) but subscription.trial_ends_at=2026-11-29 (future, UI shows '5 days remaining'); /api/public/budget-calc on that account records a free_tool_usage and returns 429 on second call.

critical.issue: Trial users whose user.trial_ends_at is stale (past) but subscription.trial_ends_at is still future are treated as 'free' by the gate and METERED. Root cause: server.py line 4100 calls _compute_access_state(user) without loading the sub doc; the function falls back to user.subscription_status + user.trial_ends_at and returns a non-trial state. /auth/me loads the sub and returns 'trial' correctly, so the UI shows the trial banner while the metered-tool gate silently blocks after 1 call. Reproduced live on trialactive@example.com: UI banner says 'Trial: 5 days remaining', yet 2nd budget-calc POST returns 429 cooldown_active.

action_items: HIGH: In /app/backend/server.py, patch _enforce_free_tool_limit (and audit _require_paid_plan for the same latent bug) to load the latest subscription doc and pass it to _compute_access_state. Suggested: sub = await db.subscriptions.find_one({'user_id': user['id']}, sort=[('updated_at',-1)]); state = _compute_access_state(user, sub). Mirrors how /auth/me computes access_state. Otherwise any trial account whose user.trial_ends_at wasn't kept in sync by the trial-refresh/webhook pipeline will see false 429s on D2 tools — a paying-customer-facing bug.
OPTIONAL: Backfill user.trial_ends_at from the latest subscription doc for all trialing users (one-shot) to self-heal pre-existing fixtures until the gate is patched.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_enforce_free_tool_limit` and `_require_paid_plan` both call `_compute_access_state(user)` without the sub doc — same latent bug surface. `_compute_access_state` already accepts an optional sub param. Standardise on passing sub at every call site.

/app/memory/test_credentials.md says trialactive 'trial_ends_at refreshed to now+5d' — but only the subscription doc was refreshed, the user doc still carries 2026-11-07. Either the trial-refresh helper must update both, or the gate must always consult the sub.

rca of the issue: Trial user metering regression. The Nov 24 2026 trial-refresh (per test_credentials.md) updated subscriptions.trial_ends_at to now+5d but left users.trial_ends_at pointing at the original 2026-11-07. /api/auth/me correctly returns access_state='trial' because its computation passes the subscription doc into _compute_access_state. BUT the D2 free-tool gate (_enforce_free_tool_limit, server.py line 4100) calls _compute_access_state(user) WITHOUT the sub doc; the function then reads user.subscription_status='trialing' and _trial_end_dt(user.trial_ends_at)=2026-11-07 < now, triggering _downgrade_state(user) -> 'free'. The user is then treated as a free member and metered at 1/120d. Fix: sub = await db.subscriptions.find_one({'user_id': user['id']}, sort=[('updated_at',-1)]); state = _compute_access_state(user, sub). Short-term mitigation: backfill users.trial_ends_at from the active subscription.
